Resource Profile: NG Patient

Official URL: https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/StructureDefinition/ng-patient Version: 0.0.0
Draft as of 2026-08-17 Computable Name: NgPatient
Other Identifiers: OID:2.16.840.1.113884.3.9944.1.42.59

Nigeria Core Patient Profile

Usages:

  • Use this Profile: Bundle NG AEFI Report, Bundle NG Immunization SMART Scheduler, Bundle NG (IPS) and Bundle NG Referral MNCH
  • Refer to this Profile: NG HIV National ART Register, NG HIV Enhanced Adherence Counselling Monitoring Register, NG HIV Integrated Laboratory Monitoring Register, NG HIV Pharmacy Daily Worksheet... Show 38 more, NG HIV Tracking Register, NG Allergy Intolerance, Ng Appointment, NG CarePlan, NG ClaimResponse, NG Claim, NG Communication, NG Condition, NG Claim Coverage Eligibility Request, NG Claim Coverage Eligibility Response, NG Claim Coverage, NG DeviceRequest, NG Device, DiagnosticReport (IPS), Nigeria Document Reference, NG Encounter, NG Alert Flag, NG Goal, NG ImmunizationRecommendation, NG Immunization, NG Invoice, Bundle NG IPS Composition, NG MedicationDispense, NG MedicationRequest, Nigeria Medication Statement, NG Alcohol Use Observation, NG Pregnancy EDD Observation, NG Pregnancy Outcome Observation, NG Pregnancy Status Observation, NG Laboratory or Pathology Result Observation, NG Radiology Result Observation, NG Tobacco Smoking Status Observation, NG Composite Observation, NG Procedure, NG RelatedPerson, NG ServiceRequest, NG Specimen and NG Task
  • Examples for this Profile: Patient/NgPatient-001-Pseudo, Patient/NgPatient-001, Patient/NgPatient-002, Patient/NgPatient-003... Show 2 more, Patient/NgPatient-Consent-001 and Patient/Patient-Chika-Okafor
  • CapabilityStatements using this Profile: Authoritative Nigeria Core Server Requirements, Nigeria Core General Hospital Registry Service Capability, Nigeria Core General Hospital Requestor Capability, Nigeria Core General Hospital Responder Capability... Show 6 more, Nigeria Core PHC Registry Service Capability, Nigeria Core PHC Requestor Capability, Nigeria Core PHC Responder Capability, Nigeria Core Tertiary Referral Registry Service Capability, Nigeria Core Tertiary Referral Requestor Capability and Nigeria Core Tertiary Referral Responder Capability

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
